title: Microsoft Teams: expanded Markdown support in the compose box
summary: The briefing passes: the compose-mode behaviour and rollout windows match Microsoft's notice, and the roadmap fields match the current record. Independent searches confirmed the narrowly stated documentation gaps. The summary should describe general availability as planned rather than settled.

claims.claim: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax.
